description:
Saudi Arabia has been urging Trump to keep attacking Iran, and he’s headlining a Saudi investment conference today.

MBS, the leader of Saudi Arabia, has wooed Trump for years.

He's been so successful that Trump's billions are intimately tied to Saudi Arabia's wealth.

Producer/Host: Trevor Hayes
Editor: @niklaak
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: The Prince Pushing Trump To Stay At War With Iran

description:
Republicans are handing precious public lands to foreign corporations and billionaires.

We went to Superior National Forest, which is on the verge of being sacrificed to a Chilean mining company.

Americans want public lands protected, but Trump and the GOP want profit.
